programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Sally Mae Hassona grew up in Australia.When she was very young, she started training kickboxing, then football, and in 2012 she became interested in boxing.That's how she got into the amateur league.As a talented player, she won the Golden Gloves Championship.Some time later she became a trainer.Together with her Egyptian husband, they are the parents of two children.They moved to Cairo four years ago.Women's boxing is a completely new phenomenon in this city.Society often cannot accept that women practice this "men's sport".However, Sally Mae Hassona decided to start her own boxing academy: Impact Sports Academy.There he trains girls and boys from poor families.She also hopes that in the future, her students' fighting skills will enable them to defend themselves against violence.Some of Sally's students successfully participate in competitions organized by the federation in Egypt.The woman's children also train, and her son became a boxing champion.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska once again managed to reach the titular "end of the world", despite restrictions, difficulties in traveling, and the fact that the thirteenth series of the program could have been the unlucky one.During the uncertain time of the pandemic, she showed viewers moving stories that gave hope that miracles can be achieved even in the most difficult circumstances.She produced an extraordinary series of stories from Dubai, Georgia, Kenya, Malawi, Egypt and Romania.Now viewers will learn the behind-the-scenes of all these expeditions.For the host of the program, it is also a sentimental journey - one of the heroines of the reports, Raha Moharrak, just like her, reached for the Crown of the Earth, and in the desert in Dubai, Martyna Wojciechowska met her colleagues from the Dakar Rally: Marek Dąbrowski and Jacek Czachor.In Kenya, she appeared in a music video for a gospel song by Darlan Rukish.However, during filming in Malawi, she refused to eat a roasted mouse.This is just some of the information that will appear in the episode.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc:
The program returns to the air after a break.Over the last few months, Martyna Wojciechowska and her team have traveled all over the world to look for inspiring women who will talk about what is currently most important.For some topics, the host had to wait many years, but for the good stuff, it's definitely worth it.The latest season will bring meetings with the oldest and youngest heroines in the history of the show.Viewers will see episodes shot in eight countries and on five continents.However, it is not about records or the number of kilometers traveled.The most important thing is meeting another person, time spent together, intimate conversation, and the truth about the world
The whole world heard about Anja Ringgren Loven in 2016.All because of a photo showing a woman giving water to an extremely exhausted two-year-old who was close to death in a Nigerian village.The boy accused of witchcraft was driven out of his home.He wandered for a long time before help arrived.In Nigeria, they still believe in magic and use it to explain all misfortunes and accidents.People living in poverty and deprived of the opportunity for education may, under the pretext of accusing them of witchcraft, get rid of another person to feed from their home.Martyna Wojciechowska's heroine, Anja, has been active in this country for years.She founded the "Land of Hope" organization, which deals with rescuing and providing a safe haven for children suspected of being associated with evil forces.

programs.title: Dodo Heroes
programs.desc: Inspiring stories about animals in need and the people who help them.Each episode highlights deep bonds between various representatives of the animal world and the people who save and care for them.In the program, viewers meet a former British Marine officer, Pen Farthing, who organized the adoption of over 700 stray dogs by soldiers serving in Afghanistan.They will also see an Australian family saving baby koalas.Animals need help after being hit by winter cyclones.Another extraordinary man in the program will be Derrick Campana, who creates prosthetics tailored specifically to the individual needs of animals, helping everyone from elephants to rabbits.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew Zimmern begins another culinary adventure, during which he will again taste the strangest dishes in the world, from wild goat to duck liver.In the new season of the show, Andrew will taste snake eggs in Japan and drink snake bile in Shanghai.In Okinawa, people eat pickled pig's ear, poisonous urchin fish and tuna eye.Finally, he will go to China to try turtle, chicken hearts and snail shells.Viewers will find out whether Andrew will survive such a difficult test.
